description: Find the search_jobs filters and the job fields that match some keywords, with each one's type and a short description. Pass words such as ["pay", "remote"]; no keywords lists everything. kind is filter (pass it in search_jobs filters) or field (a property of each returned job; postings[].x is a property of each linked posting). A field state is an object whose state says whether the source published the value (known), Atlas derived it, the source omitted it, or extraction failed.
name: list_fields
title: List job fields and filters
